title: Sugarcane stir spreads to several Haryana districts

ai.summary: Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have intensified protests demanding a higher state sugarcane price (SAP) from ₹430 to ₹600 per quintal, spreading to Kurukshetra, Ambala, Rohtak, Karnal and Kaithal districts as crushing operations face delays.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have intensified protests demanding a higher state sugarcane price (SAP) from ₹430 to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: The sugarcane farmers’ agitation in Haryana has entered its second week, spreading across several cane-growing districts and disrupting the start of the crushing season. Growers are increasingly worried about delays in clearing their fields for wheat sowing.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have intensified protests demanding a higher state sugarcane price (SAP) from ₹430 to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: The agitation demanding a hike in the sugarcane state advised price (SAP), launched by the Bharatiya Kisan Union- Charuni (BKU-Charuni) at Saraswati Sugar Mills in Yamunanagar on November 15, has gained momentum with several other farmers’ organisations, particularly the Bharatiya Kisan Union- Tikait (BKU-Tikait), extending support.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have intensified protests demanding a higher state sugarcane price (SAP) from ₹430 to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: BKU (Tikait) Haryana president Ratan Mann said that the agitation will continue until the government increases the SAP to ₹600 per quintal and all farmers of the state are united and will jointly fight for their demand.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers in Haryana have intensified protests demanding a higher state sugarcane price (SAP) from ₹430 to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: The government increased the SAP from ₹415 per quintal in 2025-26 to ₹430 for the current season and announced a further increase to ₹450 for 2027-28. Farmers have rejected the hike of ₹15 as inadequate, citing rising expenditure on diesel, fertilisers, pesticides, irrigation, machinery and labour.
